Excludes registration and other non-tuition charges.

requirements.general: Pass Malaysian Certificate of Education (Sijill Pelajaran Malaysia – SPM) or equivalent with a minimum of 3 credits, including Mathematics, and pass English; OR Pass a Malaysian Higher School Certificate (STPM) or equivalent, with a minimum of Grade C (NGMP 2.0) in any subject, and credit in Mathematics and pass English at SPM level; OR Pass a Malaysia Higher Religious Certificate (Sijil Tinggi Agama Malaysia – STAM) with a minimum of Maqbul (pass) and credit in Mathematics and pass English at SPM level; OR Pass a Level 3 SKM in the relevant field and pass a Malaysian Certificate of Education (Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia – SPM) with a minimum of 1 credit in any subject with credit in Mathematics and English pass; OR Certificate or its equivalent in the relevant field International students Pass IGCSE O-Level or equivalent with a minimum of 3 subjects with grade "C" or better, including Mathematics
